name: com.unity.xr.androidxr-openxr
description: Enables you to build mixed reality apps for Android XR devices by implementing support for Android XR extensions.

_upm.changelog:
### Changed
- Changed the minimum supported Android SDK version to API level 25 for Unity 6.3+ and level 26 for Unity 6.5+, matching the minimum supported SDK versions for each Unity version.
- Android XR: Performance Metrics and Hand Mesh Data features now being included as default in Android XR feature group.
- Moved `AndroidXRSettingsInitializer` asset file from the **Assets** folder to the **ProjectSettings** folder and renamed it to `AndroidXRSettingsManager.asset`.

### Fixed
- Fixed usages of APIs that were deprecated in AR Foundation 6.5 and Unity 6.3.
- Fixed internal build logic so that builds from the Unity 6.6 alpha now correctly contain their Android App Manifest entries.
- Fixed settings management singleton so it no longer modifies its underlying asset during import, preventing related warnings.
